meetings.title: 1st Meeting 2024
meetings.summary: In today's meeting, the appointment of the Committee chair and Deputy chair of the committee was scheduled. Senior Officer Shifna Ali presided over the selection process of committee's chairperson and vice chairperson. South Fuvahmulah Constituency Member Ibrahim Hussain proposed to elect South Feydhoo Constituency Member Ibrahim Didi as the Chair of the Committee. It was seconded by Gadhdhoo Constituency Member Mohamed Ali. Below are the voting details of the appointment. Vote: To elect South Feydhoo Constituency Member Ibrahim Didi as the Chair of the Committee Total number of members: 04 Number of members present: 04 Voted Yes: 04 Voted against 0 Abstain: 0 Required to Pass: 03 Result: Passed Hence, South Feydhoo Constituency Member Ibrahim Didi was elected as the Chair of the Committee. Then, Gadhdhoo Constituency Member Mohamed Ali proposed to elect South Fuvahmulah Constituency Member Ibrahim Hussain as the Vice Chair of the Committee. It was seconded by Thoddoo Constituency Member Hussain Sameer. Below are the voting details of the appointment. Vote: To elect South Fuvahmulah Constituency Member Ibrahim Hussain as the Vice Chair of the Committee Total number of members: 04 Number of members present: 04 Voted Yes: 04 Voted against 0 Abstain: 0 Required to Pass: 03 Result: Passed Hence, South Fuvahmulah Constituency Member Ibrahim Hussain was elected as the Vice Chair of the Committee. Then, Thoddoo Constituency Member Hussain Sameer proposed the committee quorum as 3 members, which was seconded by Gadhdhoo Constituency Member Mohamed Ali. Below are the voting details of the appointment. Vote: To decide the committee quorum as 3 members. Total number of members: 04 Number of members present: 04 Voted Yes: 03 Voted against 0 Abstain: 0 Required to Pass: 02 Result: Passed Hence, the committee quorum was decided to be 3 members.
